text: Josh Jacobs (finger surgery) is out Sunday against the Vikings and could miss multiple weeks. Kaleb Johnson had 14 carries for 68 yards and a touchdown after Jacobs left last week.
Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) is questionable for the 9:30 AM ET kickoff against the Patriots in Munich. Set that lineup spot early.
Update: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is questionable for Sunday in Germany after limited practices Thursday and Friday. TreVeyon Henderson is out, so Corey Kiner still gets work either way.
David Montgomery (groin) is questionable after a full practice Friday. Woody Marks (knee) was cleared and plays.
Kenneth Walker (groin) is questionable for Sunday against the Falcons.
T.J. Hockenson (wrist), Kyler Murray (hamstring) and Jauan Jennings (calf) are out against the Packers. Jordan Addison (thumb) is questionable.
Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) is out against the Browns, which means more targets for Tank Dell, Nico Collins and Kayshon Boutte.
Jake Ferguson (knee) is out against the 49ers. George Pickens (hamstring) is off the injury report and set to return.
Commanders 24, Giants 21 on Thursday night. Isaiah Likely (27.7 PPR) and Cam Skattebo (27.2) led all scorers; Jayden Daniels threw 3 TDs.
TreVeyon Henderson (illness) is out for Week 10, so Corey Kiner should lead the Patriots backfield.
Puka Nacua (knee, turf toe) is headed to IR. The Rams hope to have him back around Week 14 or 15.
Malik Willis (groin) is on IR. Rookie Kyle McCord makes his first start Sunday against the Colts.
Rookie Fernando Mendoza is the Raiders' new starting quarterback. A small step down for Brock Bowers.
Gardner Minshew (elbow surgery) is out for the season. Rookie Carson Beck makes his first start for the Cardinals against the Rams.
Kirk Cousins is back in Minnesota, traded from the Raiders. He's expected to start, a boost for Justin Jefferson.
Josh Downs was traded from the Colts to the Chiefs.
Keenan Allen was traded from the Colts to the 49ers.
Jalen Hurts (blood clots) is out for the season.
Terry McLaurin (knee) is out for the season.
Sam Darnold (quad, ribs) is out for Week 10.
The Eagles traded DT Jordan Davis to the Jaguars for a 2027 first-round pick (No. 24 in our draft order) and a 2029 second.
The Falcons traded S Jessie Bates III to the Jaguars for a 2027 second-round pick (No. 55 in our draft order) and a 2028 fifth.
Patrick Mahomes' elbow MRI showed no major injury. He's expected to play Sunday at Atlanta.
Jacoby Brissett traded to the Ravens. He's starting while Lamar Jackson is on IR.
The Saints claimed RB Audric Estime off waivers from the Browns.
Davante Adams is ahead of schedule after hamstring surgery. Sean McVay expects him back on the short end of 6-10 weeks, possibly Week 12 or 13.
